title: UEFA chief Ceferin calls for Infantino to quit but rules out replacing him
summary: Aleksander Ceferin, president of the European soccer confederation (UEFA) has announced that he will not run against Gianni Infantino but warned the under-fire FIFA president that he must either quit or face a leadership challenge in March.
